documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Upcoming Board Meeting Of The Company.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of INR 121 crores, representing a 60% YoY growth driven by strong demand in its retail and wholesale segments. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 18 crores with a 14.9% margin, while profit after tax reached INR 9 crores. Management outlined retail expansion plans across Gujarat, including store openings in Surat, Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar. The company is also progressively shifting toward Gold Metal Loans to hedge gold inventory and manage working capital efficiently. RBZ Jewellers reported strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with operational revenue increasing by approximately 60% year-on-year to INR 1,208 Mn and PAT reaching INR 91 Mn.

guidance.claim: The capex break-even for new stores is expected to be achieved in a year or less.
guidance.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 50-50 revenue mix between B2B and B2C segments in a year or two, and 75-25 long term with retail contributing 75%.
guidance.quote: For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: The company expects 18 carat gold to comprise at least 20% of its corporate sales mix by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: So we have introduced this since December, our sales mix in corporate, before it was 100% 22 carat, I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

guidance.claim: Revenue growth was in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: Delivered a healthy quarterly performance, with revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

guidance.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
guidance.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company is not providing forward growth guidance for the current year.
guidance.quote: There is no guidance for this year, frankly saying.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue from operations grew 60% YoY to INR 121 crores, driven by robust consumer demand and higher jewellery sales.
demand_outlook.quote: For the quarter under review, revenue from operations stood at INR121 crores registering a strong growth of 60% Y-o-Y with a revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust consumer demand, higher jewellery sales and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Retail revenue grew 70% YoY to INR 78 crores, while wholesale revenue grew 47% YoY to INR 42 crores in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of segmental performance for the quarter, retail revenue stood at INR78 crores registering a robust 70% Y-o-Y growth. Wholesale revenue stood at 42% reflecting a strong 47% Y-o-Y growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Corporate demand was good in Q1 and management anticipates a favorable response from the B2B segment ahead of Quarter 3.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the demand, all the corporates are giving us orders because of the upcoming season that is Quarter 3 and demand in corporates for Quarter 1 has also been good. I think we are anticipating a good response from the B2B side as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand outlook for Q2 appears promising as the company enters the upcoming festive season.
demand_outlook.quote: And the demand side looks to be good and promising for Quarter 2, as we are approaching.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: RBZ Jewellers continues to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the upcoming wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: At the company's retail store, consumption comprises 35% daily wear and 65% occasion wear.
demand_outlook.quote: The consumption is approximately 35% of daily wear and 65% of occasion wear.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for 18-carat gold is experiencing higher growth compared to 22-carat gold.
demand_outlook.quote: 18 carat is generally picked up more in terms of growth, 18 carat is gaining more growth than 22 carat.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores carry a carpet area of 10,000 square feet with INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores in inventory deployment.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area. The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Small format stores require inventory deployment of around INR 50 crores plus or minus 10% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex incurred for the upcoming Surat store is approximately INR 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: RBZ Jewellers plans to expand its retail footprint with new showrooms in Surat and Rajkot targeted to open by Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring mid-sized store locations of around 5,000 square feet in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Each upcoming large-format store will require an estimated inventory allocation of INR 125 crores to INR 150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We anticipate about INR125 crores to INR150 crores of inventory for each store.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 18 crores with a 14.9% margin, while Profit After Tax was INR 9 crores with a 7.5% margin.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%. Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins were impacted by stagnant average gold rates, lease asset amortization of INR 76 lakhs, and lease liability impact of INR 115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So, on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that. There is other two impacts that are there: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Employee expenses were higher after hiring 52 to 60 employees for upcoming store openings.
Full-year FY26 EBITDA reached INR 92 crores, with margins expanding 233 basis points to 14.44%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Factory capacity stands at 1.8 to 2 tons per year, with current utilization running at around 50%.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year. And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During peak festive months, factory capacity utilization increases to between 70% and 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the season times, currently as of now, our capacity utilization generally goes at 70%, 80% minimum, 75%, 85% sometimes, depending on which days are all, sometimes it is near to 90% or so.

orders_capacity.claim: Strong design appreciation from corporate customers resulted in full order books for July and August.
orders_capacity.quote: There has been a good, successful appreciation of designs even from corporate end, because of which the July, August order kitty are full.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's manufacturing plant capacity utilization is currently around 50% to 55%.
orders_capacity.quote: The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company holds a sanctioned debt of around INR 300 crores, which is sufficient to fund four store launches in the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: RBZ Jewellers expects its debt-to-equity ratio to remain below 1:1 by the end of the financial year before gearing up to 1.5 to 2:1 using Gold Metal Loans.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity. Over the period of time we are wanting to gear up this to 1.5 or 2:1 debt equity ratio, wherein major leverage will be through Gold Metal Loan

capital_allocation.claim: Management plans to fully churn inventory into hedged positions using Gold Metal Loans over a three-year period.
capital_allocation.quote: GML we are planning that during the course of the journey we should actually have an inventory which is hedged. We have already started using GML in this quarter, a little bit, but as and when the quarter passes we want to completely churn over the whole inventory to go hedged. But that will take three year of time that I, as you have said.

capital_allocation.claim: RBZ Jewellers plans to explore Gold Metal Loan facilities to fund gold inventory for upcoming store openings.
capital_allocation.quote: So we will be exploring GML in this financial year perhaps for buying -- the new buying of gold that will happen for the upcoming stores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management targets maintaining debt-to-equity levels around 1:1, with potential leverage up to 1:1.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We want to stay -- we want to keep the debt levels at 1:1 ratio ideally or 1:1 point, maybe leverage to 1.4, 1.5.

risks_headwinds.claim: Stagnant average gold prices in Q1 resulted in negligible inventory gain across the system.
risks_headwinds.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Holding unhedged gold inventory in open positions exposes the business to commodity volatility risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now what you talk about the inventory levels, it is a directional call that we have taken that on an ongoing business if we were to, put our inventory and this amount of inventory onto, let's say in an open position, it is going to call for risk.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that recent import duty and authorization policy changes on gold are not advantageous, though the actual ground-level impact is being monitored.
risks_headwinds.quote: Certainly, I think these restrictions are not advantageous, but up to what level there is an impact is crucial.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to maintaining a debt-to-equity ratio below 1:1 by the end of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a 50-50 revenue mix between B2B and B2C segments within one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects 18 carat gold to represent at least 20% of corporate sales mix by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have introduced this since December, our sales mix in corporate, before it was 100% 22 carat, I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26

management_commitments.claim: Retail expansion includes flagship showrooms in Surat by Q2.
management_commitments.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

management_commitments.claim: RBZ Jewellers targets commencing operations at its new Surat and Rajkot showrooms by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: RBZ Jewellers plans to expand to four retail stores within the current calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We are going to have, let's say, 4 stores in this calendar year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
